extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and stores. A brand name; usually left untranslated.

extDescription.message: Intercepts loads, classifies them with a local server, blocks or shows the result, and supports per-image whitelist overrides.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser and stores.

countsInitial.description: Popup tally before the live count arrives.

countsLine.description: Popup tally of allowed vs blocked images on the active tab. $1 = allowed count, $2 = blocked count.

healthChecking.description: Popup status while contacting the local classifier.

healthInvalidEndpoint.description: Popup status when the configured endpoint URL is malformed.

healthModelNotLoaded.description: Popup status when the server is up but no model is loaded.

healthTokenRequired.message: Classifier: token required — paste server token
healthTokenRequired.description: Popup status when the server needs a token that hasn't been entered.

healthIdentityUnverified.message: Classifier: identity NOT verified — possible impersonation
healthIdentityUnverified.description: Popup status when the server fails the HMAC identity challenge.

healthUnreachable.description: Popup status when the server can't be contacted.

healthVerified.description: Popup status prefix when the server's identity is verified; technical details are appended after it.

taxaLabel.description: Unit label after a taxa count, e.g. '5000 taxa'.

optEnabled.description: Checkbox: master on/off switch for filtering.

headingDetectionMode.description: Section heading for the speed/accuracy presets.

presetFast.description: Name of the fastest detection preset.

presetBalanced.description: Name of the balanced detection preset.

presetBalancedDesc.description: Sub-label for the Balanced preset (adds the MobileCLIP model).

presetAccurate.description: Name of the most-thorough detection preset.

presetHintNeedsVoter.message: $1 need the server started with that voter installed.
presetHintNeedsVoter.description: Hint shown when one or more presets are unavailable. $1 = preset name(s), e.g. 'Balanced & Accurate'.

summaryAdvanced.description: Disclosure toggle that reveals advanced settings.

fieldEndpoint.description: Label for the local classifier URL field.

fieldToken.description: Label for the server token field.

phToken.description: Placeholder instructing where to get the server token.

optShowToken.description: Checkbox that reveals the masked token field.

optSendData.description: Checkbox to also POST the image bytes, not just the URL.

optFailClosed.description: Checkbox: fail closed (block) if the server can't be reached.

optStrict.description: Checkbox: block everything until the classifier explicitly allows it.

optScanBackgrounds.description: Checkbox to also filter CSS background images.

headingTuning.description: Section heading for the threshold/salience sliders.

sliderBlockMore.description: Left end label of a tuning slider (more aggressive blocking).

sliderBlockLess.description: Right end label of a tuning slider (less aggressive blocking).

btnSave.description: Button that saves the advanced settings.

btnSaved.description: Transient confirmation shown on the Save button after saving.

saveEndpointLocal.description: Transient error on the Save button when a non-local endpoint is entered.

backupNote.message: Save your setup to a JSON file or load one. The file holds only your detection mode, sliders, toggles, and endpoint — never your server token or any allowed/blocked URLs.
backupNote.description: Explanatory note above the export/import buttons.

btnExport.description: Button that downloads settings as a JSON file.

btnImport.description: Button that loads settings from a JSON file.

flashInvalidFile.description: Transient error when an imported file can't be parsed.

headingWhitelist.description: Section heading for per-image whitelist entries.

headingDomains.description: Section heading for whole-site allow entries.

headingBlocklist.description: Section heading for per-image block entries.

listEmpty.description: Shown in a list that has no entries.

btnRemove.description: Button that removes a single list entry.

privacyNote.message: Your settings and lists are stored locally in this browser (chrome.storage.local) and never leave your machine. Image classification is done by the local server you point to above.
privacyNote.description: Privacy note at the bottom of the popup.

placeholderBlocked.description: In-page placeholder text for a hidden image with no stated reason.

placeholderBlockedReason.description: In-page placeholder text for a hidden image. $1 = short reason from the classifier.

overlayLabel.description: Accessible label for the debug 'explain decision' overlay.

overlayDismiss.message: click or press Esc to dismiss
overlayDismiss.description: Tooltip on the debug overlay describing how to close it.

menuAllowImage.description: Right-click context-menu item to allow the clicked image.

menuBlockImage.description: Right-click context-menu item to block the clicked image.

menuAllowDomain.message: ImgEdge: Allow all images from this site
menuAllowDomain.description: Right-click context-menu item to allow the whole site.

menuExplain.description: Right-click context-menu item to show the debug decision overlay.

badgeUnreachable.description: Toolbar-icon tooltip when the classifier can't be reached.

badgeModelMissing.message: ImgEdge — model not loaded; not filtering
badgeModelMissing.description: Toolbar-icon tooltip when the server has no model loaded.

badgeCounts.description: Toolbar-icon tooltip tally. $1 = allowed count, $2 = blocked count.
